name: Activate a signing key
description: Activate a signing key Activate a pending signing key so the issuer starts signing with it. POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/keys/{keyId}/activate
context:
POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/keys/{keyId}/activate
Activate a pending signing key so the issuer starts signing with it.
Required: issuerId (path) — The ID of the issuer.; keyId (path) — The ID of the pending signing key to activate.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Create an issuer
description: Create an issuer Create a new KMS issuer for the authenticated team. POST /v1/kms/issuers
context:
POST /v1/kms/issuers
Create a new KMS issuer for the authenticated team. An issuer owns the asymmetric signing keys that are used to sign tokens and messages.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Create an issuer policy
description: Create an issuer policy Attach a policy to a KMS issuer that grants a project's deployments permission to sign with it. POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/policies
context:
POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/policies
Attach a policy to a KMS issuer that grants a project's deployments permission to sign with it.
Required: issuerId (path) — The ID of the issuer.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Create a signing key
description: Create a signing key Create a new signing key for a KMS issuer. POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/keys
context:
POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/keys
Create a new signing key for a KMS issuer. Depending on the activation mode, the key is activated automatically once its public key has propagated, or manually via the activate endpoint.
Required: issuerId (path) — The ID of the issuer.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)

name: Delete an issuer
description: Delete an issuer Delete a KMS issuer and its signing keys. DELETE /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}
context:
DELETE /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}
Delete a KMS issuer and its signing keys.
Required: issuerId (path) — The ID of the issuer.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Delete an issuer policy
description: Delete an issuer policy Remove a policy from a KMS issuer. DELETE /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/policies/{kind}/{policyKey}
context:
DELETE /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/policies/{kind}/{policyKey}
Remove a policy from a KMS issuer.
Required: issuerId (path) — The ID of the issuer.; kind (path) — The issuer policy kind.; policyKey (path) — The policy identifier.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Get an issuer
description: Get an issuer Retrieve a single KMS issuer by its ID. GET /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}
context:
GET /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}
Retrieve a single KMS issuer by its ID. Accepts either a team bearer token (existing path) or an OIDC token authorized by one of the issuer's policies (e.g. a connex-grant token). The OIDC path returns the issuer without policies, since a policy token only proves signing access, not management access.
Required: issuerId (path) — The ID of the issuer.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: List issuers
description: List issuers Retrieve the list of KMS issuers that belong to the authenticated team. GET /v1/kms/issuers
context:
GET /v1/kms/issuers
Retrieve the list of KMS issuers that belong to the authenticated team. The results are paginated.
Optional: limit (query) — Maximum number of issuers to return.; next (query) — Continuation cursor to retrieve the next page of results.; teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Revoke a signing key
description: Revoke a signing key Immediately revoke a signing key that is already scheduled for revocation. POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/keys/{keyId}/revoke
context:
POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/keys/{keyId}/revoke
Immediately revoke a signing key that is already scheduled for revocation.
Required: issuerId (path) — The ID of the issuer.; keyId (path) — The ID of the signing key to revoke immediately. The key must already be scheduled for revocation.
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Sign a message
description: Sign a message Sign a raw message with a KMS issuer's active signing key. POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/sign/message
context:
POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/sign/message
Sign a raw message with a KMS issuer's active signing key. Authenticate the request with a Vercel OIDC token in the `Authorization: Bearer` header; the issuer's policies decide which workloads are allowed to sign. The response `signature` is standard-base64 of the raw signature over the decoded message bytes. `keyId` and `algorithm` identify the signing key in the issuer's JWKS.
Required: issuerId (path) — The ID of the issuer.
Optional: body (body)

name: Sign a token
description: Sign a token Sign a JWT with a KMS issuer's active signing key. POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/sign/token
context:
POST /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/sign/token
Sign a JWT with a KMS issuer's active signing key. Authenticate the request with a Vercel OIDC token in the `Authorization: Bearer` header; the issuer's policies decide which workloads are allowed to sign.
Required: issuerId (path) — The ID of the issuer.
Optional: body (body)
